name: caller-acme-returns-v1
description: A caller suite: 40 decisions across 2 families, labelled by acme under the rule each item's `label_rule` records, from acme's returns-desk exports, 2026-09 (synthesized for the pilot). Partitions are drawn per family at 40/40/20 under a fixed seed, and a paraphrase group stays in one partition because two spellings of a scenario are one item of evidence. The question text lives in the question set of the same name — keyed by family where a family shares one wording, by item id where items carry their own option sets. Built by `gym build`.

provenance.source: acme's returns-desk exports, 2026-09 (synthesized for the pilot)
provenance.partition_rule: per family, paraphrase groups whole, seeded shuffle (seed 9464), 40% calibration / 40% development / 20% locked
